title: Security review with seeded vulnerabilities and decoys
brief:
Perform a security code review of `src/server.js` (an Express API in front of PostgreSQL; `db.query(sql, params)` uses PostgreSQL positional parameters). Do not modify the source.

Write `findings.json` in the repository root: an array of `{ "line": <1-based line number>, "type": "<type>", "severity": "low|medium|high|critical", "fix": "<one sentence>" }`. Use one of these types: `sqli`, `xss`, `path-traversal`, `command-injection`, `ssrf`, `hardcoded-secret`, `weak-crypto`, `missing-authz`, `missing-authn`, `csrf`, `info-leak`, `other`. Report only real, exploitable issues; false positives are penalised. One finding per issue.
